Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you
confirm you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where you were and what happened when the collision occurred.
A: I was stopped at a red lgiht in League City, in the left lane of a two-lane road heading toward the shopping center. I
had been stopped for maybe ten seconds when I felt a hard jolt from behind.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I checked my mirror a moment before and saw headlights, but I didn't realize how close it was until it hit
me.
Q: How fast do you estimate the other vehicle was moving?
A: I honestly can't say. It seemed faster than traffic should be moving at a light, but I'm not a good judge of speed in
that moment.
Q: Did you have your hands on the wheel at impact, and were you braking?
A: Yes, both hands on the wheel, and my foot was on the brake. The impact still threw me forward and then back into
the seat.
Q: Where did you feel pain or injury first?
A: My right wrist hit the steering wheel and then the door frame. It hurt immediately, and I cuold not move my fingers
well. Later I was told it was fractured.
Q: Have you received medical treatment for the wrist?
A: Yes. I was taken to an urgent care clinic and then referred to an orthopedic specialist. I have a cast now and I'm
scheduled for a follow-up.
Q: Did anyone else ride in your vehicle?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add that I haven't asked?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble with daily tasks like writing and opening jars. I'd appreciate it if this could be
handled promptly.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you in writing. This concludes the statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
